name: Screen tutorials
description: Use when editing a screen recording or tutorial: zoom where the action is, cut the waiting, keep the thinking that matters, and never hide a step the viewer needs to follow along.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

Zoom in on the typing in this screencast
Write a tutorial README for the API
